description.value: The Shed is an open-air wood-fired pizza and coffee bar perched at Cypress Village, offering panoramic views stretching from Mount Baker to Vancouver Island. It operates year-round as a relaxed pop-up patio with no reservations — cyclists can simply roll up, grab a slice, and take in the mountain air. Come winter, it doubles as an après-ski venue with fire pits and seasonal cocktails.
